name: Ghostonix Buttons
author: ghostonix

sections.description:
Ghostonix Buttons helps WooCommerce store owners add clean, branded action buttons to order confirmation and order details pages.

Use it to place helpful post-purchase actions exactly where customers need them, such as setup guides, tutorial videos, support links, tracking pages, onboarding steps, or social destinations.

The WordPress.org version is fully functional on its own and includes up to three configurable action buttons, flexible label and URL settings, box styling controls, button styling controls, alignment options, and WooCommerce order URL placeholders.

A separate Pro package is available outside WordPress.org for users who need more buttons, additional placements, shortcode placement, and advanced workflow options. Premium code is not included in this WordPress.org package.

Features

  • Add up to three WooCommerce order action buttons.
  • Display buttons on WooCommerce order confirmation and order details pages.
  • Customize button labels, URLs, colors, and text colors.
  • Customize the help box title, subtitle, background, border, and radius.
  • Control button radius, size, and alignment.
  • Open links in the same tab or a new tab.
  • Use WooCommerce order placeholders: {order_id} and {order_key}.
  • Create a cleaner, more helpful post-purchase customer experience.

Third-party Services

Ghostonix Buttons includes the Freemius SDK for optional account connection, licensing, software updates, upgrade checkout, and basic usage/diagnostic data when the site administrator chooses to opt in or purchase/activate a paid plan. Data may be sent to Freemius only through those admin-initiated flows.

Service: Freemius
Service URL: https://freemius.com
Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/

  • Added up to three configurable WooCommerce order action buttons.
  • Replaced inline style output with WordPress enqueue functions.
  • Refreshed plugin page assets and readme presentation.

1.0.3

  • Initial Freemius-ready release.
